title: Minimum Genetic Mutation
description: Find the minimum number of mutations to transform startGene to endGene using a bank of valid mutations.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize queue with [startGene, 0]
2. Add startGene to visited
3. While queue is not empty:
4. Pop [currentGene, steps]
5. If currentGene == endGene, return steps
6. For each gene in bank:
7. If gene is one mutation away and not visited, add to queue
